name: NFL player outcome engine -- Phase 1 clean-forward protocol
status: FROZEN (v1.1). Amended before the clean-forward window started. Any change after the window starts creates a new protocol version and restarts the window at the next unplayed week.

burned_data.reason: 2025 and 2026 wk1-3 were examined by v2/v3/v4/v5 gates, Phase 0 and Phase 0B; no score on them may be presented as out-of-sample.

clean_forward_window.start: the first 2026 REG week in which every game kicks off after the recorded freeze timestamp of the Phase 1 model version (models, code, hyperparameters, feature lists and gates hashed and committed); never earlier than 2026 week 5
clean_forward_window.freeze_record: nfl_models/nfl_player_outcome_phase1_freeze.json must exist (git commit SHA, file hashes, UTC timestamp) before the first scored kickoff
clean_forward_window.minimum_for_verdict: diagnostic interim reporting may begin after 4 complete weeks; inferential interim analysis requires >= 8 complete weeks; no production promotion on any interim result; the final Phase 1 promotion verdict is made after the complete frozen window, preferably through 2026 week 18; forecasts stay append-only throughout

model_versions.phase1: to be frozen by freeze record; component families fixed below

incumbent_production.name: nfl_yardage_v2 (served)
incumbent_production.note: trained on 2023-2025; valid for 2026 forecasting; its 2025 scores are in-sample and never used as comparison

comparators.historical_blend_baseline: per-game average of the outcome: season-to-date blended with prior season at 3 games' weight (Phase 0B definition)
comparators.team_blend_baseline: same blend for team plays/dropbacks/rushes/targets/red-zone plays

data_versions.source: nflverse-data GitHub releases (schedules, stats_player, snap_counts, pbp, pbp_participation, injuries, weekly_rosters, players, depth_charts)
data_versions.forward_rule: each forecast uses only files downloaded before its forecast timestamp; the downloaded files' hashes are logged with the forecast

forecast_times.primary_T24h: forecast timestamp = kickoff - 24h. Inputs: completed games, the latest injury/practice/roster information whose information timestamp <= forecast timestamp (for nflverse injuries, which carry no timestamp, the documented assumption in nfl_phase1_data.py AS_OF_ASSUMPTIONS applies and is logged), previous week's roster status, depth-chart snapshot with dt <= forecast timestamp
forecast_times.secondary_T90m: 90 minutes before kickoff: T24h information + game-day roster status (active/inactive). Phase 0B audit: 0.0% of 5,395 'INA' players and 0.01% of 8,225 'RES' players had snaps (2024-2025), so weekly roster status is a game-day snapshot and is NOT available at T24h.

eligible_universe.definition: player whose most recent game (strictly before the target week) was for this team within the team's previous 3 games, with >= 3 career game rows, meeting prior-usage eligibility; membership never uses target-game participation

prior_usage_eligibility.RB rushing: mean carries over last 3 game rows >= 5
prior_usage_eligibility.defense: >= 3 prior games with defensive snaps, mean defensive snap share over last 3 >= 0.30

availability_handling.model: P(active) per player, logistic, features: final report status, final practice status, previous-week roster status, games missed, prior snap share (T24h); + game-day roster status (T90m)
availability_handling.forecast_form: pregame mixture: P(inactive) point mass at 0 + P(active) x conditional distribution; a limited-role adjustment enters only through the conditional model's availability features
availability_handling.scored_universe: pregame universe (non-participants score actual = 0); conditional (played-only) scores are reported as secondary diagnostics

definitions.rushing_yards: official box-score rushing yards (stats_player_week.rushing_yards), REG season
definitions.routes_proxy: count of the player's team dropbacks (qb_dropback=1, excl. spikes, 2-pt, penalty no-plays) on which he is listed in pbp_participation.offense_players; unavailable when participation is not published (never imputed as 0)

targets.component_definitions: pbp-derived counts as in Phase 0B (team plays, dropbacks, rushes, targets, red-zone plays; player carries, targets, receptions, air yards, YAC, red-zone opportunities); pbp vs box score: rushing yards identical, receiving yards differ on 0.5% of rows (mean |diff| 0.06)

feature_families_allowed: player history (volumes, shares, efficiency rates, shrunk)
team environment history (plays, pass rate, red-zone rate)
opponent allowed-rates and defensive scheme profiles (box, coverage, pressure, blitz) -- component level only
availability (injury report, practice, roster status at the allowed forecast time)
role priors (draft capital, depth chart snapshot before forecast time, rookie)
schedule context known pre-game (home/away, rest, week)
feature_families_forbidden: bookmaker spreads, totals, prop lines or odds (any sportsbook-derived number)
realized participation of teammates or defenders in the target game
observed game-time weather (forecast weather only, if added)
any quantity computed from 2026 forward-window outcomes before they are final

distributions: 80% and 50% central interval coverage and width
binary: AUC reported as ranking-only, never as accuracy

component_gates.rule: At freeze every component architecture is already selected using burned development data only (2022-2025, 2026 wk1-3). During the forward window the frozen component forecast AND its pre-registered baseline forecast are both produced and logged before kickoff; neither replaces the other after results are observed. At final evaluation a component that fails its comparison is recorded as failed; it may block promotion and may inform a future version, but it is never retroactively swapped for its baseline on the same window. Any replacement is a new model version evaluated only on later games.
component_gates.comparison: frozen component vs its baseline, paired week-block bootstrap (2,000 resamples), one-sided p reported; pass threshold p < 0.10 for component diagnostics

pass_requires_all: median forecast MAE lower than historical_blend_baseline and than incumbent_production (rushing/receiving) with paired week-block bootstrap one-sided p < 0.05
mean forecast RMSE not worse than historical_blend_baseline (p_worse >= 0.05)
CRPS lower than a residual-quantile baseline built around historical_blend_baseline (p < 0.05)
anytime TD: logloss and Brier lower than the Phase 0 incumbent-style classifier re-fit through the last pre-window week, p < 0.05; ECE <= 0.03
end_to_end_gates.secondary_outcomes: all other outcomes in targets.definitions are reported with the same metrics; no pass/fail
end_to_end_gates.evaluation_universe: pregame universe at T24h (primary); T90m and conditional universe reported as secondary

abstain: team has no completed game this season and no prior-season games
forecast inputs downloaded after the forecast deadline
flag_not_abstain: P(active) < 0.5 at T24h -> publish mixture with 'likely inactive' flag
route proxy unavailable -> target-share chain, flagged
80% interval width above the 90th percentile of its outcome -> 'high uncertainty' flag

retraining.allowed_inside_version: pre-registered weekly walk-forward (prequential) refit: a completed forward week enters the training set for later weeks once its outcomes are official. Code, features, hyperparameters, priors, architecture, thresholds and calibration method cannot change.
not_allowed_inside_version: changing eligibility, universe, targets, metrics, gates or shrinkage priors
any change motivated by forward-window results
any fallback/replacement of a component by its baseline
triggers_for_new_version: a data-source schema break that makes a component undefined (document, freeze v1.x, restart window)
an invariant test failure (fix, new version, restart window)
retraining.forbidden: rescue-tuning the same version after inspecting forward-window results

logging.forecast_log: append-only JSONL, one record per player-outcome with forecast timestamp, input file hashes, model version hash, mean, median, quantiles, P(active)
logging.scoring: after each week's official stats are final; scores appended, never overwritten
logging.invariants: tests/test_nfl_player_outcome_invariants.py must pass on the frozen version before the window starts and after every weekly refit
logging.availability_source_timestamps: every availability forecast logs the information timestamp (or assumed timestamp and assumption id) of each input record

production: Phase 1 runs in shadow mode only; production serving is unchanged until the end-to-end gates pass on the forward window.

amendments_v1_1.change: removed post-hoc fallback of a failed component to its baseline at window end
amendments_v1_1.reason: choosing between component and baseline after observing forward-window results is test-set model selection; every component architecture must be selected on burned development data before freeze

amendments_v1_1.change: T-24h uses the latest officially available injury/practice/roster information whose information timestamp is <= the forecast timestamp; never a report published later; source timestamp (or documented assumed timestamp) logged with every availability forecast
amendments_v1_1.reason: a final injury report does not exist exactly 24 hours before every kickoff (Thursday/Monday/international games; late designation changes)

amendments_v1_1.change: diagnostic interim reporting after 4 complete weeks; inferential interim analysis only after >= 8 complete weeks; no production promotion on any interim result; final promotion verdict after the complete frozen window (target through 2026 week 18)
amendments_v1_1.reason: 4 week-clusters cannot support a week-clustered promotion inference

amendments_v1_1.change: weekly walk-forward refit allowed only as the pre-registered algorithm: completed forward weeks may enter training for later weeks once official; code, features, hyperparameters, priors, architecture, thresholds and calibration method cannot change
amendments_v1_1.reason: clarify that prequential evaluation is not permission to tune from forward results
